summary: This clinical trial tested a study drug called tirzepatide in adults who are overweight or have obesity and have chronic kidney disease, with or without type 2 diabetes. Chronic kidney disease means the kidneys are damaged and have trouble filtering blood. The study used special scans to look at fat in and around the kidneys. Eli Lilly and and Company sponsored this Phase 2 study, which had 134 participants and is now completed.
